evidence.summary: Past incident INC-1001 (postgres_pool_exhaustion): orders-service 5xx spike after traffic increase. Root cause: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion. The traffic surge from the flash sale saturated the fixed pool of 100 connections, slow queries held connections longer, and requests queued until they timed out and returned 5xx.

metadata.root_cause: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion. The traffic surge from the flash sale saturated the fixed pool of 100 connections, slow queries held connections longer, and requests queued until they timed out and returned 5xx.
metadata.remediation: Raise the connection pool size within the database max_connections budget, put PgBouncer in front of PostgreSQL, terminate idle-in-transaction sessions, rate limit campaign traffic, and restart the service only if connections have leaked.
